title: feat: auto-claim first API key quest
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Auto-claims the 0.25-Pollen first API key quest after dashboard or BYOP key creation
- Runs only the existing D1 account-setup quest group in the background
- Keeps every other quest manually claimable
- Reuses the existing idempotent reward ledger and atomic claim path
- Adds focused route and quest-checker coverage

gist.headline: First key, first pollen
gist.blurb: Making your first API key now quietly gathers its own welcome pollen. The hive handled the paperwork while you were busy building.
gist.summary: Creating a first API key from the dashboard or BYOP now automatically claims the existing 0.25-Pollen account-setup quest through the idempotent atomic reward path, while all other quests remain manual.
gist.impact: New developers receive their 0.25 Pollen welcome reward immediately after creating their first key, with no separate claim step or duplicate-reward risk.
gist.visual_concept: Polli has just created a shiny first API key at a cozy retro terminal, and a small 0.25 Pollen seed-reward drops neatly into her wallet garden on its own. A code-plant labeled "FIRST KEY" blooms beside the monitor, representing automatic onboarding while the rest of the quest flowers remain waiting to be picked manually.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener tool belt, creating a glowing first API key at a retro CRT terminal while a small pouch marked "0.25 POLLEN" gently lands in her flower-filled wallet garden; a code-plant beside her blooms with simple pixel text "FIRST KEY". Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
